Markets.title: How Warren Buffett's 'big error' may finally be paying off after a decade
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett's 2016 acquisition of Precision Castparts, previously called an expensive mistake, is now valued at about $100 billion. Supply shortages and a rival acquisition by GE Aerospace have significantly increased the company's value.

Markets.title: Oriental Insurance hopes to turn corner in FY27 assisted by NSE stake dilution
Markets.summary: Oriental Insurance Company expects to achieve a profitable financial turnaround by the 2026-27 fiscal year. This recovery will be supported by a planned dilution of its stake in the National Stock Exchange through an upcoming initial public offering.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| From floor trading to AI algos: Why India’s retail traders are entering the automation era, says Shruti Jain
Markets.summary: AI-powered algorithmic trading is becoming increasingly accessible to Indian retail investors due to Sebi's regulatory framework, trading APIs, and zero-code platforms. According to Shruti Jain of Arihant Capital, this automation helps improve execution and reduce emotional bias for retail traders.

Markets.title: Inside NSE IPO journey: Why India's largest exchange took 10 long years to reach Dalal Street
Markets.summary: After a decade of regulatory and legal delays, including a co-location controversy and a Supreme Court settlement, the National Stock Exchange is finally preparing for an initial public offering. The upcoming market debut will consist entirely of an offer for sale, allowing current shareholders to sell their existing stakes without raising new capital for the exchange.

Markets.title: Nifty may rebound to 23,800; Rupak De picks Apollo, Laurus Labs and Eternal for the week

Markets.summary: Over 200 companies, including Hindustan Copper and Cochin Shipyard, have set record dates this week for corporate actions such as dividends and stock splits. Victoria Mills and Sharda Motor Industries lead the dividend payouts at Rs 50 and Rs 20 per share, respectively.

Geo-Political.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
Geo-Political.summary: Russia struck a stationary Ukrainian locomotive near the Polish border shortly after Boris Johnson and other top European officials departed from the station. Former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson condemned the attack, questioning the logic behind Vladimir Putin's decision to target the train.

Geo-Political.title: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
Geo-Political.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump dismissed warnings about artificial intelligence risks, stating they will not happen. He argued that the United States must advance in AI to maintain its competitive edge against China.

Geo-Political.title: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
Geo-Political.summary: Six people died and 130 are missing after the Virgo Transport 8 ferry capsized in the Java Sea. Ships and helicopters are currently searching for the missing passengers following the accident, which was caused by bad weather.

Geo-Political.title: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists
Geo-Political.summary: Turkish police detained dozens of individuals during raids targeting gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ+ activists. Human rights groups accuse the Turkish government of using a family-values campaign to target the LGBTQ+ community.

Geo-Political.title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
Geo-Political.summary: The Iran conflict is reshaping relationships among BRICS nations and exposing their internal divisions. While members agree on the need for a new global order, they remain divided on what should replace it and how to achieve it.

Geo-Political.title: Trump doubles down on united Ireland comments on day two of visit
Geo-Political.summary: During his visit to Ireland, US President Donald Trump reiterated his support for a united Ireland. He stated at the Irish Open on Sunday that many people agree with his controversial remarks.

Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of the Federal Reserve's September meeting, Donald Trump urged the United States to adopt the world's lowest interest rates despite rising inflation and oil prices. Meanwhile, officials stated that Trump would defend Fed nominee Kevin Warsh’s independence.

Data & Insights.title: Rate hikes are back? Kevin Warsh and G7 central banks face inflation test this week
Data & Insights.summary: The Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and Bank of Japan are holding key interest rate meetings this week. These central bank decisions will test global inflation strategies and reshape monetary policy for 2026 and beyond.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 647 Rural Self Employment Training Institutes shift to digital platforms
Data & Insights.summary: India has shifted its 647 Rural Self Employment Training Institutes from paper-based assessments to a digital platform. This reform aims to improve transparency and speed while helping rural youth link skills, certification, and credit to build sustainable livelihoods.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Billionaire Club: Who’s richest in India, China, Russia, Brazil? Net worth of Ambani, Zhang Yiming, others
Data & Insights.summary: Billionaires from BRICS nations rank among the world's wealthiest individuals. During the BRICS Summit, Indian billionaire Gautam Adani met with South African President Cyril Ramaphosa to discuss strengthening trade and investment.

Data & Insights.summary: This week's economic focus centers on key data releases regarding inflation trajectory and export growth. Additionally, market events will monitor developments surrounding the NSE IPO.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal hails BRICS New Delhi Declaration, says grouping amplifying Global South voice - 'A collective resolve'
Data & Insights.summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal praised the unanimous adoption of the New Delhi Declaration at the BRICS 2026 Summit. He stated that the declaration demonstrates the group's shared commitment to fostering a resilient, innovative, and development-driven partnership that amplifies the voice of the Global South.

India.title: PM Modi Holds Bilateral Talks With South Africa, Philippines, Egypt Leaders
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi held bilateral talks with the leaders of South Africa, the Philippines, and Egypt. The discussions focused on boosting cooperation in trade, investment, defence, and people-to-people ties.

India.title: Sheesh Mahal Row Returns? Panel To Inspect Arvind Kejriwal's Former House
India.summary: A committee led by BJP MLA Ajay Mahawar will inspect the former official residence of Arvind Kejriwal. The panel will examine the renovations made during the AAP administration and the public funds spent on the property.

India.title: AI Must Not Get Out Of Control: South Africa President At BRICS
India.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa warned at the BRICS summit that artificial intelligence must not be allowed to get out of control. His remarks highlight ongoing global concerns about the rapid pace of developing increasingly powerful AI systems.

India.title: Punjab Government Claims Power Crisis Over, Opposition Isn't Convinced
India.summary: The Punjab government claims the state's power crisis is over, but the opposition remains unconvinced. In response, the Punjab Congress has scheduled a major protest outside the PSPCL headquarters in Patiala on Monday.

India.title: Trinamool Names Candidates For Nandigram, Rejinagar Bypolls
India.summary: The Trinamool Congress has announced its candidates for the Nandigram and Rejinagar bypolls. The Nandigram bypoll occurred after Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari vacated the seat to retain Bhabanipur.

India.title: Opposition States Skip BRICS Meet, Six BJP Chief Ministers Join
India.summary: Chief ministers from opposition-led states including Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, and Himachal Pradesh skipped a recent BRICS meeting. In contrast, six chief ministers belonging to the BJP attended the gathering.

General.title: Reform confident it won't need to repay any of £72m under proposed new donor rules
